answer: Proposal: new accounts need m verifier signatures; each verifier locks a slashable bond and burns one opal credit per signature from a budget of B per epoch, so an orchard of cloned keys cannot exceed real verifier capacity: supply caps at V·B/m. A fraud bounty pays whoever proves two endorsed accounts share one controller; the endorsers' juniper bonds pay out and both accounts are void. Rule: cap each account's lifetime reward below the price of m slots, so k spare accounts cost k·m slots and return less. Leak: colluding verifiers can still mint up to their own cap.
